text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув is hard on herself and others,
but
always looks out for those in need.
She is the
Empress that many
Umamusume look up to.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In pursuit of her dream to be the ideal
for all
Umamusume, she prepares to take
on the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
